summary: We are executing on two major content launches—the China Going Global report and the Knowledge Website redesign—while urgently finalizing social media agency selection and prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China for SEO.
summaryDetail: The top priority is the China Going Global report, a joint CKGSB-IE publication launching in Singapore in September 2025, with chapter edits due this week and op-eds and case studies being sourced. Simultaneously, the Knowledge Website redesign is moving forward after selecting an editorial layout that shows more articles and brings indices to the homepage, with design adjustments due from Joker. Urgently this week, we must submit ratings for social media agency proposals and expedite selection, as the process has been delayed. For SEO, the team has committed to prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with participant profile analysis and keyword targeting underway; US partnerships are deprioritized. Additionally, the 'Business for Good' book publication page needs to be created by July 27, and the Indonesia program title has been approved. Finally, all team members must update Outlook passwords to resolve account lockouts.
